messages:
Samira Patel: Hey team — running ~45m late. Flight delayed, need someone to pick up primary from 22:00–23:30 UTC. I can shadow until 22:15 then disconnect. @Jules @Kai any availability?
Jules Chen: I can take 22:00–23:15 but I have a short customer call at 23:15. Can do the initial triage and hand to Marcos if needed.
Kai Park: I can shadow for the whole window until 23:30 and take any escalations during that time. Happy to swap primary after 23:15 if Jules needs to drop.
Marcos Ortega: I can cover 23:15–00:00 if that helps. Prefer to take full handoff at 23:15 rather than mid-incident.
Samira Patel: Sounds good. Plan: Jules = primary 22:00–23:15, Kai = shadow 22:00–23:30, Marcos picks up 23:15–00:00. I'm updating the rota and escalation list now.
IncidentBot: [incident created] INC-2026-489 | severity: P2 | summary: telemetry: eu-west1 p95 latency spikes. No confirmed customer-facing errors yet. Link: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-2026-489
Samira Patel: Heads-up — alert: latency-p95 > 800ms in eu-west1. I ran the first two runbook steps (verify traffic, check infra). Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/latency-spike. Preparing KV cache flush if p95 doesn't drop.
Jules Chen: On it. Quick checklist I'm going to follow: 1) confirm alert scope, 2) check pod restarts and cpu throttling, 3) confirm model-pool saturation.
Kai Park: I pushed a temporary dashboard note and pinned the telemetry. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/team/ops/d/latency-eu-west1.
Marcos Ortega: If this escalates to P1, remember to page L2 and call the oncall phone. Jaime is L2 tonight — tag @L2 Pager.
Samira Patel: Command I used to inspect cache keys (FYI):
```
kubectl -n redwood exec -it deploy/kv-cache -- redis-cli --scan | wc -l
```
Jules Chen: If we need to rotate caches I'll run:
```
kubectl -n platform exec deploy/cache-rotator -- /bin/sh -c "curl -XPOST http://localhost/rotate"
```
Samira Patel: Noted. Also left note in rota doc: https://docs.redwood.com/ops/rotation — marked Jules primary and Marcos fallback.
Kai Park: Small telemetry note: p95 dropped to ~680ms after a few pods cycled but errored again at 22:18. I'll keep an eye on pod restarts (kubectl get pods -n model-serving).
Jules Chen: Starting triage now. I'll update thread with next actions and the short-form triage results.
Marcos Ortega: Adding fallback command in case we need to route to smaller model pool quickly:
```
redwood-cli failover --region eu-west1 --to fallback-pool --reason "latency spike"
```
Samira Patel: Thanks all — I'm handing the primary to Jules now, Kai will shadow. I'll post again if anything changes or when I'm back online. :thumbsup:
